newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin Airport traffic up 20 pct in May-Aer Rianta.
newsitem.headline: Dublin Airport traffic up 20 pct in May-Aer Rianta.

text.p: More than 931,000 passengers passed through Dublin Airport in May, a 20 percent increase over the same month last year, Irish airports authority Aer Rianta said on Monday.
All markets performed well with transatlantic traffic up 20 percent, UK traffic up 24 percent and domestic traffic up two percent.
Strong growth to European destinations resulted in a 14 percent increase in this market, Aer Rianta said in a statement.
It said that more than 3.6 million passengers have used the airport in 1997 to date, a 13 percent increase on the same period of 1996.
"With the buoyant holiday season under way, Dublin is preparing itself for its busiest year ever," Aer Rianta said.
